name: supply-analogue-transfer-v1
features: Solver net load after fixed generation, actual group availability, and supported thermal source costs. No observed prices or generation targets.
distance: Equal three block weights; equal zones within each block, equal groups within zone. Whole-European 24-hour day profile or same-UTC-hour vector. Training-only scaling.
load_scale: max(Jan hourly std,0.1*Jan maximum absolute net load,0.05GW)
availability_scale: max(Jan hourly std,0.1*Jan mean,0.01*zone Jan peak absolute net load,0.001GW)
source_cost_scale: max(Jan supported hourly std,10 EUR/MWh); unavailable costs use own supported January mean for distance only; never-supported groups omitted from cost distance.
three_day_weights: Inverse squared standardized distance, normalized; availability-positive donor-hour support, neutral fallback if absent.
transfer: Economic markups only. Actual target-hour availability/source anchors unchanged. Whole-system methods share donors across zones; neighbor-zone method shares donors across technologies within each zone.
support: Compare target nearest distance to January nearest-other-day 95th percentile; diagnostic, not an acceptance cutoff.
selection: No February-target method tuning or checkpoint reselection; report every predeclared method. Source checkpoint previously selected with February validation, so no untouched-test claim.
scope: Exploratory January→February curve transfer, all48 zones and672 hours; no new fit, baseline adoption or annual claim.
neighbor_zone_day: Nearest January UTC day per zone, equal physical-feature weight on own zone and neighboring zones jointly; neighbors split their half equally, using retained corridor adjacency. Each zone transfers all technology curves from its donor day. Market clearing still couples all48 zones.
